notes.title: Release! But the work is not finished yet
notes.content:
We have completely moved the main gameplay of ICED, but we want to add some more features: 

- Leaderboards 
- Saves
- Nightmares (4 scenarios)
- Co-op for 2 players
- Support workshop to download custom localization
- System the use of wood and ice for the construction. Burning plastic debris and wood for heating.
- locomotion
